name: Uerii Token
fix_description: mint is public with no access control. Anyone can call it to mint 100M tokens to themselves for free. Add onlyOwner modifier or remove the function entirely.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward missing access control exploit: the attacker simply calls an unrestricted mint() function and swaps the minted tokens through Uniswap. The PoC is short, linear, and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond basic token swaps.
